relations.text: 2026年3月10日に合併契約を結び、ユニファーストの全株式を取得する(取引額は約55億ドル)
relations.text_en: On March 10, 2026, Cintas agreed to acquire all outstanding UniFirst shares in a deal valued at about $5.5 billion

source.label: Cintas 10-K(2026年5月期)
source.quote: On March 10, 2026, the Company entered into a Merger Agreement pursuant to which the Company will acquire all outstanding shares of UniFirst common stock.
